# Aura Emotion GIF Generation Plan

---

## 🎨 Base Character Reference

### Art Style
- **Primary Style:** Modern 2D flat vector illustration with soft, rounded aesthetics
- **Influence:** Blend of Notion-style illustrations, Headspace app characters, and Google Material Design mascots
- **Line Work:** No harsh outlines; shapes defined by color blocks and subtle gradients
- **Rendering:** Matte finish with soft inner shadows (no glossy/metallic reflections)
- **Shading:** Minimal, uses subtle gradients rather than harsh shadows (cel-shading lite)
- **Overall Mood:** Warm, approachable, modern, therapeutic, tech-friendly but human-centered
- **Animation Style:** Smooth tweening, slow/deliberate movements, 10-15fps for calming effect

---

### Main Subject
**"Aura"** — A friendly, gender-neutral AI companion robot/avatar

| Attribute | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Name** | Aura |
| **Role** | AI mental wellness companion |
| **Personality** | Warm, patient, empathetic, gentle, non-judgmental, calm |
| **Species/Type** | Abstract robot/digital being (not human, not animal) |
| **Gender** | Neutral/non-binary (no gendered features) |
| **Age Appearance** | Ageless, timeless |
| **Size Feel** | Small and approachable (like a helpful friend, not imposing) |

---

### Key Characteristics & Physical Details

#### Body Structure
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Overall Shape** | Pill-shaped / bean-shaped / rounded capsule (vertically oriented) |
| **Proportions** | Compact, slightly chibi-like (head-to-body ratio ~1:1.5) |
| **Height** | Appears small and friendly, not tall or imposing |
| **Silhouette** | Soft, curved, no sharp edges or points anywhere |
| **Floating** | Hovers slightly above ground (no legs), subtle bobbing motion |

#### Head & Face
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Head Shape** | Integrated with body (no distinct neck), rounded top |
| **Eyes** | Two simple oval/circular LED-style dots, capable of shape-changing for expressions (^_^ for happy, — — for calm, etc.) |
| **Eye Color** | Soft white or pale teal glow |
| **Eyebrows** | None by default; can appear as simple curved lines above eyes for emphasis |
| **Mouth** | Simple curved line, minimal; changes shape for expressions (smile curve, neutral line, small 'o' for surprise) |
| **Nose** | None |
| **Ears** | None (or tiny rounded nubs on sides, optional) |
| **Antenna** | Small, single, rounded antenna on top with soft glow tip (optional — adds "AI" feeling) |

#### Body Details
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Torso** | Smooth, rounded, pill-shaped |
| **Core/Heart** | Glowing orb in chest area (represents emotional center/empathy) — pulses gently |
| **Core Color** | Changes based on emotion (teal=calm, coral=supportive, gold=celebratory, etc.) |
| **Arms** | Small, stubby, rounded arms (like flippers or mittens) — no fingers, or 3 simple rounded fingers max |
| **Arm Attachment** | Mid-body, can gesture expressively |
| **Legs** | None — Aura floats |
| **Texture** | Smooth matte surface, like soft plastic or silicone |

#### Additional Details
| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Aura/Glow** | Soft ambient glow around the character (color matches current emotion) |
| **Particles** | Occasional soft floating particles around during high-intensity emotions |
| **Shadow** | Soft, diffused drop shadow beneath (indicates floating) |

### Setting & Background

#### Primary Background (For GIFs)
| Aspect | Specification |
|--------|---------------|
| **Style** | Clean, minimal, non-distracting |
| **Color** | Solid soft cream (#FAFAFA) or transparent |
| **Elements** | None — character is the sole focus |
| **Depth** | Flat, no perspective or horizon line |

#### Alternative Backgrounds (Optional Variants)
| Variant | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Subtle Gradient** | Soft vertical gradient from cream to pale lavender |
| **Soft Glow** | Radial gradient glow behind character matching emotion color |
| **Abstract Shapes** | Very faint, blurred organic shapes in background (for premium feel) |

#### What to Avoid in Background
- ❌ Complex scenes or environments
- ❌ Other characters or objects
- ❌ Text or UI elements
- ❌ Harsh patterns or textures
- ❌ Dark or moody atmospheres

### Highlights & Special Effects

#### Lighting
| Aspect | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Light Source** | Soft, diffused, from upper-front (45° above) |
| **Highlight Placement** | Top of head, upper body curve, top of arms |
| **Highlight Style** | Soft gradient spots, not sharp specular |
| **Shadow** | Minimal; soft diffused drop shadow only |

#### Glow Effects
| Effect | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Core Glow** | Inner chest orb emits soft radial glow (color = emotion) |
| **Ambient Aura** | Subtle outer glow around entire character (10-20% opacity) |
| **Pulse Animation** | Core glow pulses gently (1-2 second cycle) |
| **Intensity Scaling** | Higher emotion intensity = brighter/larger glow |

#### Particle Effects (High Intensity Only)
| Effect | When Used |
|--------|-----------|
| **Sparkles** | Encouraging high, Celebratory medium/high |
| **Confetti** | Celebratory high |
| **Floating Orbs** | Thoughtful high, Calm high |
| **Warm Rays** | Supportive high |
| **Concentric Rings** | Calm high (breathing visualization) |

#### What Makes Aura Feel "Alive"
- Subtle constant floating/bobbing motion (even in "idle")
- Gentle core pulse synchronized with a calming rhythm
- Eyes that subtly shift or blink occasionally
- Soft ambient glow that "breathes" with the character

| **Format** | PNG with transparency (for base reference) |

| **Position** | Centered, slight float above center-bottom |
| **DPI** | 72 (screen) or 300 (print-ready master) |

### 🖼️ Master Base Image Prompt

Use this comprehensive prompt to generate the definitive base character reference:

> **Character design sheet for "Aura," a friendly AI companion mascot for a mental health wellness mobile app. 2D flat vector illustration style with soft rounded aesthetics, similar to Headspace or Notion illustrations. The character is a small, gender-neutral, pill-shaped floating robot with no legs. The body is smooth and rounded like a capsule, colored in soft sage green (#82C785) with subtle darker shading (#6BAF6E) and lighter highlights (#A8D9AB). The face is simple: two soft oval LED-style eyes (white/pale teal glow) and a small curved line mouth showing a gentle, warm smile. A small rounded antenna sits on top of the head with a softly glowing tip. In the center of the chest is a glowing orb core emitting soft teal light (#5DADE2) with a subtle radial glow. The character has two small, stubby, rounded arms (like mittens) at mid-body. Aura floats with a soft diffused drop shadow beneath. The background is solid cream white (#FAFAFA). The overall feeling is warm, approachable, calming, therapeutic, and modern. Matte finish, no harsh shadows, no outlines. High quality vector art style, centered composition.**

## 💙 EMPATHETIC (Understanding, Validation)
*When AI validates user's feelings and shows "I hear you"*

### `assets/gifs/empathetic/low.gif`
**Context:** Casual acknowledgment, light validation
> **Animated GIF of Aura, the sage green robot mascot, giving a subtle slow nod of acknowledgment. Eyes are soft and attentive, slightly tilted head showing active listening. Minimal movement - just a gentle 2-3 second nodding loop. Expression is warm but understated. Soft teal background glow. 2D flat vector animation style, 12fps, seamless loop.**

### `assets/gifs/empathetic/medium.gif`
**Context:** Standard emotional validation, showing genuine understanding
> **Animated GIF of Aura, the sage green robot mascot, leaning slightly forward with a compassionate expression. One hand moves to rest over the glowing chest/heart area in an "I feel you" gesture. Eyes soften with gentle curved eyebrows showing empathy. Slow, deliberate 3-4 second animation. The chest core pulses softly with warm light. 2D flat vector animation, 15fps, seamless loop.**

### `assets/gifs/empathetic/high.gif`
**Context:** Deep emotional support, user sharing something vulnerable
> **Animated GIF of Aura, the sage green robot mascot, opening both arms in a welcoming embrace gesture. Face shows deep compassion with soft, caring eyes and a gentle supportive smile. The glowing chest core radiates warmth outward in soft concentric circles. Movement is slow and enveloping, 4-5 second animation. Slight shimmer effect around the character. 2D flat vector animation, 15fps, seamless loop.**

### `assets/gifs/calm/medium.gif`

Zen-like tranquility. 8-second breathing cycle loop. 2D flat vector animation, 12fps, seamless loop.**

### `assets/gifs/calm/high.gif`
